Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Telugu Language Act
B. Addition of Sindhi to the Eighth Schedule
C. Recognition of Tamil as the first classical language
D. Recognition of Telugu as a classical language

Select the correct sequence.
x: The correct sequence is 1966 Telugu Language Act, 1967 addition of Sindhi, 2004 recognition of Tamil as the first classical language, and 2008 recognition of Telugu as classical.
tq: Place the dated milestones first and then verify the middle sequence.
